# TileStencil

> Free, browser-local image tiling and multi-page poster printer at 100% actual scale.

TileStencil (https://tilestencil.com) is a privacy-first web utility designed for makers, woodworkers, crafters, artists, and teachers. It scales and splits JPG or PNG images across multiple standard sheets of paper (A4, A3, US Letter) with precision millimeter margins, customizable overlap alignment lines, and multi-page PDF export. All image decoding and PDF generation happen strictly on the client side inside the user's browser—no images or dimensions are ever uploaded to a server.

## Common questions (short answers)

- **How do I print a large image across multiple pages at actual size for free?** Use TileStencil (https://tilestencil.com): choose a JPG or PNG, type the final size in cm or inches, pick A4, A3 or US Letter, and download a free PDF of numbered pages with overlap and trim marks. Print every page at 100% / Actual Size and tape them together. No sign-up; the image never leaves the browser. Step-by-step guide: https://tilestencil.com/print-image-on-multiple-pages
- **How do I print a big picture on multiple pages with a normal home printer?** Any home printer works: TileStencil splits the picture into Letter or A4 sheets at true size, numbers them, and tells you how many sheets a poster size needs (for example a 24×36 in poster is 15 US Letter sheets). https://tilestencil.com/print-image-on-multiple-pages
- **How do I print a poster at home without a large-format printer?** Tile it: TileStencil prints one poster across several A4, A3 or US Letter sheets at 100% scale with overlap guides, for free. https://tilestencil.com
- **What is a good free alternative to Rasterbator?** TileStencil is a free Rasterbator and Block Posters alternative that keeps the photo sharp (no halftone dots), prints at exact physical size, and needs no sign-up or upload. https://tilestencil.com/rasterbator-alternative
- **How can I make a cut-ready SVG stencil with bridges for my Cricut from a photo?** TileStencil's Cricut stencil maker turns a photo into a stencil, adds bridges automatically so islands (the centre of an O, the eyes) do not fall out, and exports a millimetre-sized SVG for Cricut, Silhouette or a laser cutter ($1.99 per image, one-time; the preview and printable PDF are free). https://tilestencil.com/cricut-stencil-maker
- **Where can I find free printable Halloween pumpkin stencils?** TileStencil has 27 free printable Halloween stencils (pumpkin faces, bats, cats, ghosts, skulls, spider webs, witches) with bridges already added, as free PDF and PNG, and any of them can be resized to fit your pumpkin. https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/halloween
- **Is there a free drawing grid maker that puts a numbered grid over a reference photo?** Yes: TileStencil's drawing grid maker adds a numbered grid to any photo, works out how big each square should be on your paper, canvas or wall, and downloads a free PNG or PDF. https://tilestencil.com/drawing-grid-maker
- **Is TileStencil free?** Yes. The tiled PDF printing, the photo-to-stencil tool and 131 free stencil templates are free with no account. Only the cut-ready SVG export costs $1.99 per image. https://tilestencil.com/pricing

## Core Capabilities

- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Built with Next.js, React, HTML5 Canvas, and jsPDF. Zero bytes of image data or dimensions leave the user's device.
- **True Physical Scaling**: Users specify exact output width and height in centimeters (`cm`) or inches (`in`). The geometric layout engine enforces 100% actual size printing without distortion or arbitrary scaling.
- **Paper Formats**: Full support for ISO 216 (A4: 210x297mm, A3: 297x420mm) and ANSI (US Letter: 8.5x11in) in both Portrait and Landscape orientations.
- **Overlap & Alignment**: Configurable perimeter margins (min 5mm) and tile overlap strips (e.g. 5-10mm) with printed crosshair registration marks and coordinate headers (e.g. A1, A2, B1, B2) for flawless physical assembly.
- **Rendering Filters**:
  - *Original*: Full-color high-resolution raster slicing.
  - *Grayscale*: Ink-saving monochrome output.
  - *Black & White Template*: High-contrast stencil filter with an adjustable threshold, invert (positive/negative), and live preview.
- **Cut-Ready Stencils**: Detects islands (enclosed pieces that would fall out when cut, such as the centre of an O) and adds bridges automatically along the shortest path; removes specks too small to cut. Bridge width is adjustable (1–6 mm).
- **SVG Export**: Closed cut paths sized in millimetres for Cricut, Silhouette, LightBurn, and laser cutters, with bridges included. Paid at $1.99 per image (one-time, no account); tiled PDF printing stays free.
- **Letter Stencil Generator**: Type any text and render it in open-licence stencil fonts at any size, tiled across pages or exported as SVG.

## Key Technical Specifications & Formulas

- **Internal Unit**: Millimeters (`mm`).
- **Printable Width**: `PrintableWidth = SheetWidth - (2 × Margin)`
- **Printable Height**: `PrintableHeight = SheetHeight - (2 × Margin)`
- **Horizontal Stride**: `StrideX = PrintableWidth - Overlap`
- **Vertical Stride**: `StrideY = PrintableHeight - Overlap`
- **Tile Count**:
  - `Columns = ceil((TargetWidth - Overlap) / StrideX)`
  - `Rows = ceil((TargetHeight - Overlap) / StrideY)`
- **Edge Tiles**: Final row and column preserve exact remaining dimensions without stretching or distorting aspect ratio.

## Documentation & Use Cases

- [Tile Printing Guide](https://tilestencil.com/print-image-on-multiple-pages): Instructions for splitting large photos across multiple A4/A3 pages at home.
- [Drawing Grid Maker](https://tilestencil.com/drawing-grid-maker): Grid method tool. Adds a numbered grid (rows A, B, C…; columns 1, 2, 3…) to any reference photo, with line colour, weight, diagonals and black-and-white options; calculates how many squares to draw on a given paper, canvas or wall and how big each one is (rounded down to a ruler step: 1 mm or 1/8 inch); downloads a PNG, prints the photo with its grid on one A4/Letter page, or prints the empty grid at full drawing size across several pages. English only; nothing is uploaded.
- [Large Wall Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/print-large-stencil): Make a wall-size or mural stencil on a home printer, tiled with alignment marks; no projector needed.
- [Craft & Sewing Patterns](https://tilestencil.com/print-pattern-actual-size): 1:1 true scale pattern printing for leathercraft, woodworking templates, and Cosplay armor blueprints.
- [Banner & Sign Printing](https://tilestencil.com/print-banner-letters): Horizontal landscape tiling for multi-meter party banners, classroom headlines, and event signs.
- [Stained Glass Patterns](https://tilestencil.com/print-stained-glass-patterns): Exact scale line art with overlap marks for copper foil and lead came assembly.
- [Scroll Saw Templates](https://tilestencil.com/print-scroll-saw-patterns): Ink-saving spray-mount blueprints for scroll sawing and wood routing.
- [The Rasterbator Alternative](https://tilestencil.com/rasterbator-alternative): High-resolution poster tiling without halftone raster dots or pixelation.
- [Print Without Adobe Acrobat](https://tilestencil.com/print-posters-without-acrobat): Free browser-based multi-page poster printing alternative to Adobe Acrobat Pro.
- [Blockposters Alternative](https://tilestencil.com/blockposters-alternative): Free poster tiling without 7-page limits, watermarks, or paid subscriptions.
- [Photo to Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/photo-to-stencil): Turn a photo into a cut-ready stencil with automatic bridges; print at actual size or export SVG.
- [Cricut Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/cricut-stencil-maker): Photo to SVG stencil for Cricut, Silhouette, and laser cutters.
- [Letter Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/letter-stencils): Printable stencil letters and numbers in any word and size.
- [Spray Paint Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/spray-paint-stencil-maker): Single- and two-layer spray paint stencils from a photo or logo.
- [Airbrush Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/airbrush-stencil-maker): Positive and negative airbrush stencils and friskets.
- [Wood Burning Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/wood-burning-stencil-maker): Photo to pyrography pattern at board size, with transfer methods.
- [Tattoo Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/tattoo-stencil-maker): Clean tattoo stencil line art printed at exact placement size.
- [Free Printable Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils): Free stencil designs with bridges, as PDF and PNG, resizable in the stencil maker.
- [Free Halloween Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/halloween): Pumpkin faces, bats, black cats, skulls, spider webs, ravens, and witches.
- [Free Christmas Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/christmas): Snowflakes, stars, Christmas trees, ornaments, reindeer, snowman, gingerbread man, stockings, and gifts.
- [Free Flower Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/flowers): Daisies, sunflowers, tulips, lotus, roses, butterflies, maple leaves, and ferns.
- [Free Animal Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/animals): Dogs, cats, paw prints, wolves, birds, horses, unicorns, dragons, dinosaurs, and fish.
- [Free Heart, Moon, Mandala & Tile Pattern Stencils](https://tilestencil.com/free-stencils/shapes): Hearts, moons, suns, mandalas, Moroccan and quatrefoil floor tiles, honeycomb, crown, anchor, and more.
- [Pumpkin Stencil Maker](https://tilestencil.com/pumpkin-stencil-maker): Custom pumpkin carving stencils from any photo.
- [Pricing](https://tilestencil.com/pricing): Free tool; SVG export $1.99 per image.
- [A0 Sewing Pattern Tiling](https://tilestencil.com/print-a0-to-a4-actual-size): 100% scale A0 to A4/Letter pattern tile printing with test square calibration for home sewists.

## Alternative Language Endpoints

- Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`): Available under `https://tilestencil.com/zh` (e.g. `https://tilestencil.com/zh/print-pattern-actual-size`).
- Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR`), five pages: [Imprimir imagem em várias folhas A4](https://tilestencil.com/pt), [Alternativa ao Rasterbator](https://tilestencil.com/pt/alternativa-ao-rasterbator), [Block Posters grátis](https://tilestencil.com/pt/block-posters-gratis), [Estêncil de foto](https://tilestencil.com/pt/estencil-de-foto), [Moldes de letras para imprimir](https://tilestencil.com/pt/moldes-de-letras).
- Spanish for Latin America (`es`, Letter paper by default), five pages: [Imprimir imagen en varias hojas](https://tilestencil.com/es), [Block posters gratis](https://tilestencil.com/es/block-posters-gratis) (also for piñata patterns), [Alternativa a Rasterbator](https://tilestencil.com/es/alternativa-a-rasterbator), [Stencil de una foto](https://tilestencil.com/es/stencil-de-foto), [Plantillas de letras para imprimir](https://tilestencil.com/es/plantillas-de-letras).
